title: AgentLensProviderDefinition
description: Schema for defining how AgentLens extracts SKILL and MCP call traces from specific Generative AI systems.

schema_version.description: Version of the AgentLens provider definition schema, e.g., '1.0'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AI provider, e.g., 'antigravity', 'claude-code'.

name.description: Human-readable name of the AI platform or agent framework.

description.description: Brief description of the provider trace format.

type.description: Ingestion mechanism used to gather raw traces.

path_patterns.description: Glob patterns or paths where session trace logs are stored (supports environment variable expansion).

child_traces.description: Trace files written by spawned subagents, stitched under the call that spawned them.

path_glob.description: Glob for child trace files; '{dir}' is the parent trace's directory and '{stem}' its file name without extension.

sidecar_suffix.description: Replaces the child trace's extension to locate its metadata JSON (e.g. '.meta.json').

parent_call_id_field.description: Dot-path in the sidecar JSON holding the spawning call ID.

tool_call_filter.description: JMESPath, JSONPath, or expression identifying tool/skill execution steps.

tool_calls_path.description: Dot-path of the array holding individual tool calls inside a matched event (e.g. 'tool_calls', 'message.content').

tool_call_item_filter.description: Filter applied to each element of tool_calls_path to select tool calls (e.g. "type == 'tool_use'").

turns.description: How user prompts that start a new conversational turn are detected.

prompt_field.description: Dot-path of the prompt. Arrays of content blocks are reduced to their text.

prompt_tag.description: Optional wrapper tag whose inner text is used as the prompt (e.g. 'USER_REQUEST').

results.description: How tool results are attached back to their tool calls.

filter.description: Filter identifying result events. Empty matches every event.

items_path.description: Dot-path of an array of result items inside the event (call_id mode).

item_filter.description: Filter selecting result items within items_path.

call_id_field.description: Dot-path of the referenced call ID (call_id mode).

step_index_field.description: Dot-path of the numeric step index (previous_step mode).

error_flag_field.description: Dot-path of a boolean that is true when the call failed.

status_field.description: Dot-path of a status string; 'error'/'failed' marks the call as failed.

timestamp_field.description: Dot-path of the result timestamp, used to derive call duration.

scopes.description: Tool calls that activate a Skill or spawn a Subagent. Subsequent calls are attributed to the opened scope until the next user turn.

tool_name.description: Exact tool name, or a prefix pattern ending in '*'.

name_field.description: Dot-path into the call arguments holding the scope name, with '||' alternatives. Empty uses the tool name.

name_regex.description: Optional regex; its first capture group is the scope name and the rule only applies when it matches.

enter_scope.description: Whether subsequent calls are attributed to the opened scope. Use false when the spawned scope logs its calls elsewhere.

mcp_server_regex.description: Regex whose first capture group extracts the MCP server from the tool name (e.g. '^mcp__(.+?)__'). A match also classifies the call as an MCP tool.
